author: Good Enough
description:
In the 1800s, parents were told that a few drops of “soothing syrup” could calm a crying child. What they weren’t told is that these tonics were packed with opium. Doctors later discovered that infants were becoming dangerously sedated, underfed, and in some cases dependent on the very medicine meant to “help” them.
